title: Use Viva Main Overview to view system layout and operate high-level system controls (Start/Stop, Bag Out, Purge, Resume/Pause all AGVs)
summary: Use the Viva main overview (Hazlet) to confirm the overall system layout is visible and to operate high-level system controls from the right-hand control area: Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, and Pause all AGVs. After issuing a control action, verify the on-screen system/AGV status area reflects the updated state.
when_to_use: Use when you need overall system visibility and to apply high-level system state actions (Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, Pause all AGVs) from the Viva main overview.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Open the Viva main overview, verify the expected layout/menu/control labels are present, execute the intended high-level control action, and confirm the on-screen system/AGV status updates.
access_or_tools_needed: Viva HMI main overview screen access (Viva screens / Overall System System Detail)

access_required: Viva HMI main overview screen access

visual_references.description: Viva main overview (Overall System / System Detail) showing: main menu subscreens (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS), system layout areas (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS), and right-hand controls & info (Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, Pause all AGVs).

steps.title: Open the Viva main overview (Overall System / System Detail) for Hazlet
steps.purpose: Get to the correct Viva screen that provides overall system visibility and the right-hand high-level controls.
steps.instruction: Open the Viva main overview screen for the Hazlet site (Overall System / System Detail).
steps.expected_result: The Viva main overview is displayed with the overall system view and the right-hand control area visible.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen shows the Viva main overview layout (system overview) and is ready for interaction with the right-hand controls.
steps.failure_condition: The Viva main overview does not load correctly or the expected overview/control area is not visible.

actions.label: Open Viva main overview
actions.exact_action: Open the Viva main overview screen (Overall System / System Detail) for the Hazlet site.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Presenter describes this as the Viva main overview for Hazlet; OCR indicates it is the main overview/home screen for system overview and navigation.

steps.title: Verify the main menu subscreens are visible (Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, RMS)
steps.purpose: Confirm you are on the correct Viva overview page with the expected navigation items.
steps.instruction: On the Viva main overview, confirm the main menu is visible and includes subscreen navigation items: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, and RMS.
steps.expected_result: The main menu shows the subscreens labeled: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, and RMS.
steps.healthy_condition: All expected menu labels are present and readable on the Viva main overview.
steps.failure_condition: One or more expected menu labels are missing or not visible.

actions.label: Check main menu labels
actions.exact_action: Confirm the main menu is visible and includes subscreen navigation items: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, and RMS.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR lists main menu subscreens: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, RMS.

steps.title: Verify the system layout areas are visible (Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, GLDS)
steps.purpose: Confirm the overview is showing the expected overall system layout regions before operating controls.
steps.instruction: On the main overview, confirm the system layout area shows the major zones/areas: Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS.
steps.expected_result: The system layout region displays labeled icons/areas for Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS.
steps.healthy_condition: All expected layout labels/regions are visible on the Viva main overview.
steps.failure_condition: One or more expected layout regions (Sorter/Tippers/Hospital/GLDS) are not visible.

actions.label: Check layout labels
actions.exact_action: Confirm the system layout area shows the major zones/areas: Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR indicates System Layout shows Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS.

steps.title: Locate the right-hand high-level controls (Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, Pause all AGVs)
steps.purpose: Identify the exact control area used to change overall system state and AGV bag-out/purge/resume/pause behavior.
steps.instruction: On the right-hand side controls & info area, locate the high-level controls labeled: Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, and Pause all AGVs.
steps.expected_result: The right-hand control area shows the labels for Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, and Pause all AGVs.
steps.healthy_condition: All expected control labels are present and available for use.
steps.failure_condition: One or more expected control labels are missing or not available.

actions.label: Check control labels
actions.exact_action: Locate the high-level controls: Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, and Pause all AGVs.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Presenter/OCR: right-hand side includes start up, shut down, bag out, purge, resume, pause all AGVs; OCR also lists controls & info including Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, view Metrics (Destinations), AGV status.

steps.title: Execute the intended high-level control action
steps.purpose: Apply the operator-selected overall system state action using the right-hand controls.
steps.instruction: Use the appropriate control (Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, or Pause all AGVs) based on your intent for the overall system state.
steps.expected_result: The selected control action is issued from the Viva main overview right-hand control area.
steps.healthy_condition: You can clearly identify and select the intended control label on the right-hand panel.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confidently identify the intended control label or the control cannot be selected.

actions.label: Select control based on intent
actions.exact_action: Use the appropriate control (Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, or Pause all AGVs) based on the operator’s intent for the overall system state.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Presenter describes the right-hand side controls for start up/shut down/bag out/purge/resume/pause all AGVs.

steps.title: Verify on-screen system/AGV status updates after the control action
steps.purpose: Confirm the control action took effect by checking the Viva overview’s on-screen system/AGV status area.
steps.instruction: After issuing the control action, observe for immediate on-screen evidence that the system state/control action took effect (including updates in the AGV status/system-state area on the Viva overview).
steps.expected_result: The Viva main overview reflects the updated overall state and the AGV status area updates accordingly.
steps.healthy_condition: You see a visible change on the Viva overview consistent with the control action (system state and/or AGV status area updates).
steps.failure_condition: No visible change occurs on the Viva overview after the Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, or Pause all AGVs action.

actions.label: Check for immediate update
actions.exact_action: Observe for immediate on-screen evidence that the system state/control action took effect (e.g., the overall system overview reflects the updated state and AGV status area updates).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the Viva overview does not update the AGV status/system state after the control action (Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, or Pause all AGVs).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Candidate evidence notes that the Viva overview includes controls & info and an AGV status area; expected behavior is that the overview reflects updated system/AGV state after control actions.

success_criteria: Viva main overview shows the system layout areas labeled Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, and GLDS.
Viva main overview shows the right-hand controls labeled Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, and Pause all AGVs.
After using a control, the Viva overview’s system/AGV status area visibly updates to reflect the new overall state.
healthy_conditions: Main menu subscreens are visible: Detail, Statistics, HMI Calculations, API, RMS.
System layout areas are visible: Sorter, Tippers, Hospital, GLDS.
Right-hand control labels are visible and usable: Start/Stop system, Bag Out, Purge, Resume, Pause all AGVs.
After a control action, the Viva overview visibly updates the system state/AGV status area.
failure_conditions: Main menu subscreens are missing (Detail/Statistics/HMI Calculations/API/RMS).
Right-hand control labels are missing (Start/Stop system/Bag Out/Purge/Resume/Pause all AGVs).
After issuing a control action, the Viva overview does not update the AGV status/system state.
escalation_guidance: If the Viva overview does not reflect any change in system/AGV status after issuing the control action, stop and escalate.
